issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks Farm.addAnimal(...) with a '-' (private) visibility, but the exercise expects addAnimal to be callable from outside (Main uses farm.addAnimal(...)) and the solution implements addAnimal as public. This visibility mismatch between the UML and the runnable/sample code/solution can confuse students about whether they should implement addAnimal as public or private.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent: update the UML in problem_statement.md to show addAnimal(...) as public ('+') so it matches the intended usage in Main and the solution, or alternatively update the example Main code to use an appropriate public API if the UML is intended to be authoritative. Preferably change the UML to '+' for addAnimal.
